scope: Full current lifecycle record schema tests
assessment: Reader/writer refuse missing, non-integer and unknown versions; invalid writes create no record
Non-object JSON and mismatched identities rejected
Parent symlink and dangling outcome link rejected rather than invent running status
Attempt started/outcome records and all business categories enforce same schema boundary without rewriting invalid bytes
limitations: Schema/version/identity boundaries only; not every business field semantics
No legacy format reader or backfill introduced
